caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armchair with a reddish-brown frame and dark, probably black, cushioned seat and backrest. The chair has straight, slightly tapered back legs and turned, fluted front legs, each ending with a small dark caster wheel. The armrests are curved and attached to decorative, carved supports. The top rail of the chair features a rectangular panel with an ornamental carving at the center, and small, gold-colored embellishments are visible at the corners and on the side supports. The seat and backrest are bordered with a row of small, rounded decorative studs. The chair is positioned on a plain, light beige background with some brown spots scattered mainly on the left side. The artist's signature, "Frank Weiner," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Armchair
